description:
VisionPay
AI-Powered Autonomous Payment Assistant
Like Ray-Ban Meta glasses meets Apple Pay - AI watches your world and handles payments intelligently.

VisionPay Blockchain Protocol

🎯 The Vision
Imagine wearing smart glasses that let you pay for things just by looking at them. Point your camera at a coffee shop logo, and your AI assistant handles the payment automatically based on rules you set. No phone, no wallet, no buttons.

VisionPay brings this future to today.

✨ How It Works
1. Set Payment Rules
"Auto-pay coffee shops under $10"
"Auto-pay transit fares under $5"
"Always ask for restaurants over $20"
2. Point Your Camera
The AI continuously watches through your camera (or wearable device), detecting vendor logos and signs in real-time.

3. Agent Decides
When a vendor is detected, the autonomous agent checks your payment rules:

Match found? → Pays automatically with HBAR or PYUSD
No match? → Asks for your approval
No button clicks needed. Just point and go.

🚀 Technology Stack
Real-Time AI Vision
Gemini 2.5 Live Flash - Multimodal streaming (video + audio)
Continuous vendor detection
Voice interaction ("I see Starbucks, paying now...")
Autonomous Blockchain Agent
Hedera Agent Kit - Makes payment decisions autonomously
Risk assessment and learning
Executes transactions based on your rules
Secure Authorization
AP2 Protocol (Agent Payments Protocol)
Cryptographically-signed delegated mandates
Audit trail for every transaction
Multi-Chain Payments
HBAR (Hedera) - Fast, low-cost transactions
PYUSD (Ethereum/Polygon) - Stablecoin flexibility
💡 Use Cases
🚇 Contactless Transit
Walk through subway turnstile, AI detects SFMTA logo, auto-pays $2.50 fare.

☕ Coffee Shop Auto-Pay
Point camera at Starbucks, agent checks mandate ("coffee under $10"), pays instantly.

🍽️ Restaurant Safety Check
Point at expensive restaurant menu, AI sees $45 price, asks for approval first.

🛒 Grocery Shopping
Scan items as you shop, agent tracks total against daily spending limit.

🎫 Event Entry
Look at event QR code, AI verifies and pays ticket fee automatically.

🎨 User Experience
Mobile-First Design
Full-screen camera view (like Instagram/TikTok)
Bottom sheet payments (swipeable event history)
Touch-optimized (large buttons, active states)
Back camera ready (perfect for phones)
Desktop Experience
Split-screen layout (camera + payment sidebar)
Real-time status (agent insights, audio visualization)
Protocol badges (Gemini, Hedera, AP2)
Autonomous Intelligence
Risk levels (low/medium/high color-coded)
Confidence scores (AI explains decisions)
Learning history (improves over time)
Daily limits ($100 safety check)
how_its_made:
🏗️ Architecture
Frontend
Next.js 15 with App Router
React 19 with Hooks
TailwindCSS 4 for responsive design
TypeScript for type safety
AI & Vision
@google/genai for Gemini Live streaming
Real-time video frame processing
Audio input/output for voice interaction
Tool calling for vendor detection
Blockchain
@hashgraph/sdk for Hedera transactions
ethers.js for Ethereum/PYUSD
hedera-agent-kit for autonomous decisions
Protocols
AP2 Delegated Mandates for authorization
Agent decision engine with risk assessment
Transaction history for learning
🔐 Security
Delegated authorization via AP2 mandates (cryptographically signed)
Daily spending limits (configurable, default $100)
Execution count limits per mandate
Risk assessment on every transaction
User confirmation for high-risk/large amounts
Audit trail for all payments
